source.copyright: ISO/IEC standard text is licensed. This manifest stores control identifiers and short titles only; control text and guidance are never reproduced.
source.verification_rule: A row is seeded only when its identifier and short title agree across at least two independent non-vendor sources (standards bodies or accredited certification bodies). Vendor pages corroborate but never count toward the two.
source.title_policy: Short title as printed in the BSI Annex A tables, spelling normalized where the other sources agree.
